applicant.name: Dr. Oliver Ritter
applicant.organisation: Provincial Health Authority, respiratory care planning

purpose: We plan pulmonary rehabilitation capacity and want to see how widespread COPD is and how often long-acting inhalers are used in each hospital.
question: Provide pseudonymised records of all adults with COPD and their medications.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Hospital = the data holder of the patient record.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: adults with COPD and the % with an active tiotropium prescription (ATC R03BB04), one decimal.
